title: Hill at Hatshepsut's mortuary temple 5,300 m from Karnak's obelisks

tellings.quote: surrounding the Hacheps Mortuary is another one of these white horse hills. Exactly 5,300 m away from the obelisks within the Carnac Temple.

plain: Near the mortuary temple of Hatshepsut, an ancient Egyptian queen, at Luxor, there is a hill that sits exactly 5,300 metres from the obelisks, the tall carved stone pillars, inside the Karnak temple complex. This comes from a researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who calls it another of his "white horse hills" and gives the measurement without naming a source. He offers it as a sign that the old sites were laid out on purpose, at set distances from each other.
